name: Gallaecian Celtic
notes: STRUCTURAL ANCESTRY / SUBSTRATE STUB (not a modelled G2P target). Gallaecian is the Celtic language of north-west Iberia (the Castro culture area), known from toponyms and personal names. It exists so that the Galician, Asturian and Leonese ancestry chains that reference it have a node to resolve to. It carries no grapheme table. A table needs a cited epigraphic or onomastic study that states the letter values it reads.
